> A hotfix: Open site, web process restarts and other actions work again on benches without `webserver_port`, and cwcli builds site addresses the way Frappe does.

### Upgrade Steps

* [ACTION REQUIRED] Install on 3.6.0: run `sudo cwcli self-update` on a shared install or `cwcli self-update` on a per-user install; it upgrades cwcli and restarts the services that were running.
* [ACTION REQUIRED] Per-user install still on 3.5.x or older: its `cwcli self-update` upgrades cwcli but does not restart anything, so after it finishes, restart each cwcli service you had running so that it runs 3.6.1:
  * Web UI: `cwcli ui --stop`, then `cwcli ui`.
  * Auto-inspect: `cwcli config auto-inspect stop`, then `cwcli config auto-inspect enable`.
  * Credential bridge: `cwcli config cred-bridge stop`, then `cwcli config cred-bridge start`.
* [ACTION REQUIRED] Shared install still on 3.5.x or older: its own `sudo cwcli self-update` cannot upgrade the shared install, so upgrade it this one time by hand:
  * Find the folders: `readlink -f "$(command -v cwcli)"` prints `<tool dir>/caffeinated-whale-cli/bin/cwcli`, and the folder that holds `command -v cwcli` is `<bin dir>`. `<owner>` is the account that owns `<tool dir>` (`stat -c %U <tool dir>`).
  * Run `sudo -u <owner> env PATH="$PATH" UV_TOOL_DIR=<tool dir> UV_TOOL_BIN_DIR=<bin dir> uv tool upgrade caffeinated-whale-cli`.
  * Run `cwcli --version` and check that it prints `3.6.1`.
  * If the shared scheduler is installed, run `sudo cwcli schedule daemon --install-service`, then `sudo systemctl restart cwcli-scheduler.service`.
  * If the machine-wide credential bridge is installed, run `sudo systemctl restart cwcli-cred-bridge.service`.
  * Each member who has a web UI running runs `cwcli ui --stop`, then `cwcli ui`.

### New Features

* `apps install`, `new-site`, `new-bench` and the web UI check each app's declared Frappe range and required apps before anything is fetched: a range that does not fit refuses with the `version-N` branch to pick, and missing required apps are installed first only with your consent (`--with-deps` in a script).
* Every `apps update` checks what the new code requires and refuses with nothing pulled when the bench or a site lacks a required app; `--with-deps` installs it first.
* Open site, `cwcli open`, the `cwcli init` banner and `cwcli axi url` use the address Frappe builds for the site, such as `http://site.example.com` or its `host_name`. When that address carries the bench's internal port on a name that is not a localhost one, the web UI warns before opening it and shows the commands that remove `webserver_port`.

### Bug Fixes

* Open site, web process restarts, `status`, `start`, `scale` and publishing work on benches whose `sites/common_site_config.json` has no `webserver_port`, such as a bench served by its hostname through a reverse proxy; cwcli reads the port from the bench's Procfile instead.
* The web UI no longer shows a blank or white page while moving between pages; it cross-fades from one page to the next.
